parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, typically made of stainless steel. It is circular and slightly domed to fit snugly on the pot.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, helping to cook food evenly and efficiently.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted or placed on the pot; it is detachable and does not move independently when in place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of aluminum for good heat conduction. It has handles on the sides for easy lifting.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds food and liquids for cooking. It distributes heat evenly across its surface for efficient cooking.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during use but can be moved or lifted by the handles when needed.
